go_1k.why: A thousand sales lines keyed by retailer, product and Date, pointing at go_retailers and go_products, stamped with Date.

go_daily_sales.why: One row per day's sale of a product to a retailer, stamped with Date, with quantity and prices; retailer and product repeat.

go_methods.why: Twelve order-method codes with their name, pointed at only by go_daily_sales.

go_products.why: One row per product keyed by Product number with line, type, brand, colour, cost and price; the sales tables point at it.

go_retailers.why: One row per retailer keyed by Retailer code with name, type and country; the sales tables point at it.
